discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: The prize has recently cycled through AI (2024) and quantum circuits (2025). Condensed matter is due another turn, and topological insulators are one of the most mature and influential discoveries not yet awarded: the Kane-Mele Z2 theory (2005) and Molenkamp's HgTe quantum-well experiment (2007) created a large field, already hold the Breakthrough, Dirac and Oliver Buckley prizes, and the topology lineage after 2016 points to them. Shoucheng Zhang's death leaves a clean trio.
